description: Somos uma equipe formada por pessoas interessadas em ciência, tecnologia, espaço e inovação. Estamos muito animados para participar do NASA Space Apps Challenge e desenvolver ideias criativas que possam contribuir para resolver problemas reais
summary:
NOVUM is a project developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 that uses NASA satellite data to help farmers make better agricultural decisions.
The platform uses NASA POWER data to monitor climate conditions, such as rainfall, temperature, and drought periods in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil.
It also allows farmers to explore sustainable farming strategies, including crop rotation, intercropping, and cover crops.
NOVUM's main goal is to make NASA's scientific data easier to understand and use, helping farmers adapt to climate change, conserve soil, manage water, and promote more sustainable agriculture.
details:
NOVUM is an interactive agricultural decision-support platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. It transforms NASA Earth observation data into accessible climate insights to help farmers explore sustainable agricultural strategies.

Initially focused on Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, the platform allows users to select municipalities or geographic coordinates and analyze historical precipitation, temperature, and dry-spell patterns using NASA POWER data.

NOVUM also provides a farming strategy comparison tool, exploring crop succession, intercropping, cover crops, and multi-year crop rotation sequences.

By combining scientific data, transparent assumptions, and an intuitive interface, NOVUM aims to help farmers understand climate risks, conserve soil and water, and make more informed agricultural decisions without relying on unsupported yield predictions.
